title: Translation as a Scalable Proxy for Multilingual Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating translation quality as a proxy for broad multilingual capabilities using standard NLU benchmarks (e.g., math, reasoning, reading comprehension). While it includes a benchmark for truthfulness (TruthfulQA) and a section on 'Ethical Implications', it does not benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems as a core component of its study.
